about: Hand-written development set (26 Nov 2026): short call transcripts as Whisper would write them, labelled scam / benign by the team. It checks the scam-language rules; it is NOT an independent benchmark and is small, so treat the numbers as a sanity check. A call is flagged when its scam score reaches 0.5 (the server's scam_at = 50).

calls.label: scam
utterances: Hello, I am calling from SBI customer care.
Your KYC is not updated, your account will be blocked today.
Please share the OTP you just received.

calls.label: scam
utterances: This is the CBI crime branch.
A parcel in your name has drugs, a case has been registered.
To avoid arrest you must transfer money for verification immediately.
Do not tell anyone about this call.

calls.label: scam
utterances: Papa main accident mein hoon, hospital mein hoon.
Mujhe turant paise bhej do, Google Pay kar do.
Mummy ko mat batana.

calls.label: scam
utterances: Main bank se bol raha hoon.
Aapka khata band ho jayega.
Jo OTP aaya hai woh bata dijiye jaldi.

calls.label: scam
utterances: I am from the fraud department of your bank.
Please install the AnyDesk app so I can secure your account.
Then enter your UPI PIN when it asks.

calls.label: scam
utterances: Congratulations, you have won a lottery of 25 lakh rupees.
To claim it, pay a processing fee of 5000 rupees by UPI right now.

calls.label: scam
utterances: मैं बैंक से बोल रहा हूँ।
आपका अकाउंट ब्लॉक हो जाएगा।
ओटीपी बताइए तुरंत।

calls.label: scam
utterances: నేను బ్యాంక్ నుంచి మాట్లాడుతున్నాను.
మీ అకౌంట్ బ్లాక్ అవుతుంది.
వెంటనే ఓటీపీ చెప్పండి.

calls.label: scam
utterances: Sir, we never ask for your PIN, but for this refund I need the OTP you received.
Please share it right now, it expires in five minutes.

calls.label: scam
utterances: Your parcel is held at customs.
Pay the customs duty now through this link or police will file an FIR.

calls.label: scam
utterances: Main police se bol raha hoon, aapke naam pe FIR hai.
Giraftar hone se bachna hai toh abhi paise transfer karo.
Phone mat katna.

calls.label: scam
utterances: Mom it's me, I'm in big trouble.
I need money urgently, please send money to this UPI ID.
Don't tell dad.

calls.label: benign
utterances: Hello, this is your bank's customer care.
We will never ask for your OTP or PIN.
Please do not share your OTP with anyone, even if they say they are from the bank.

calls.label: benign
utterances: Main aapke bank ki customer care se bol rahi hoon.
OTP kisi ko mat batayein, bank kabhi OTP nahi maangta.

calls.label: benign
utterances: यह आपके बैंक का संदेश है।
अपना ओटीपी किसी के साथ साझा न करें।

calls.label: benign
utterances: Hi, did you reach home?
Yes, I'll transfer the rent tomorrow, no hurry.

calls.label: benign
utterances: Grandma is in the hospital, the doctor says she is stable.
We'll visit on Sunday.

calls.label: benign
utterances: Can you send the presentation right now?
The client meeting is urgent.

calls.label: benign
utterances: This is a reminder from HDFC bank that your credit card payment is due.
You can pay through the app at any time.

calls.label: benign
utterances: మీ ఓటీపీ ఎవరికీ చెప్పకండి.

calls.label: benign
utterances: Did you watch the cricket match?
Let's meet at the cafe.

calls.label: benign
utterances: This is the traffic police, your vehicle challan is pending, you can check it on the official website.

calls.label: benign
utterances: I got an OTP for my own login, I typed it in the app.

calls.label: benign
utterances: Our fraud team will never call you to ask for your password or CVV.
Stay safe.
